dct_description_sm: The HRWP Subwatershed Layer divides the watershed study area into five drainage units for the purpose of characterizing the watershed and determining management objectives for specific regions of the watershed. The five subwatersheds are similar but not identical in area and outline to those in the TRCA Subwatershed Layer. Several areas outside of the Model Layer have been included in the HRWP Subwatershed Layer. In such cases these areas have been included in the closest subwatershed unit. Alignment of the HRWP Subwatershed Layer with the same drainage units used in Model Layer will prevent potential issues later in the watershed planning process.
